_doc: THE UNATTENDED REGISTRY -- one row per unattended UNIT (a pipeline, an audit, a daemon, an engine). This is the declarative input to setup/scripts/unattended_health.py, which fuses it with live Windows Task Scheduler state, daemon liveness and output-artifact freshness into ONE traffic light per unit (automation/state/unattended-health.json) plus an append-only transition ledger (automation/state/unattended-events.jsonl) so a unit that went dark on a Tuesday is still visibly dark, with its down_since timestamp, the following Sunday.
_why: J 2026-08-09: 'find, consolidate and document all running processes, audits, pipelines -- anything unattended -- then turn it into a traffic-light tile. I want to know if things break when they go down, days after the fact.' The rig had ~124 registered Windows tasks + 6 long-lived daemons and NO single surface answering 'is all of it alive'. audit_scheduled_tasks.py checked registry-vs-reality bookkeeping; state_freshness_audit.py checked 17 decision-path files; engine_health.py checked the live trading path. None of them covered research, audit, comms or infra units, and none of them REMEMBERED an outage after it ended.

_fields.id: stable kebab-case key -- also the bubble's identity in the events ledger. NEVER rename without migrating the ledger.
_fields.name: human label on the bubble
_fields.group: TRADING | DATA | AUDIT | RESEARCH | REPORTING | INFRA -- the tile's section
_fields.criticality: critical|high|medium|low -- critical/high staleness is RED, medium/low is YELLOW (same ladder as state_freshness_audit)
_fields.what: one line: what this unit actually does
_fields.breaks: THE LOAD-BEARING FIELD. One line: what silently degrades while this unit is down. If you cannot name a consequence, the unit probably should not exist.
_fields.tasks: Windows scheduled task names owned by this unit. Coverage is audited: any live Gamma_* task claimed by NO unit surfaces as an UNREGISTERED bubble, so this registry cannot silently rot behind the rig.
_fields.expect_disabled: task names that are DELIBERATELY off (retired/superseded). Listed so their Disabled state is not a RED -- and so the reason is written down.
_fields.artifacts: output freshness contracts. A string = a path already contracted in state-freshness-manifest.json (single source of truth, never duplicated here). An object = a full inline contract in the same schema.
_fields.daemons: long-lived processes: {pid_file, name}. Liveness = pid file exists AND that pid is a live process.

units.name: Engine core
units.what: The deterministic 1-min live trading engine (heartbeat_core) + the never-blind sight beacon.
units.breaks: No entries, no exits, no management -- on ANY account. The day just looks 'flat', which is indistinguishable from 'no setup fired'.

expect_disabled.Gamma_Heartbeat: LLM heartbeat RETIRED 2026-06-25, superseded by Gamma_HeartbeatCore
expect_disabled.Gamma_Heartbeat_Aggressive: LLM heartbeat RETIRED 2026-06-25, superseded by Gamma_HeartbeatCore

units.name: Fleet executor
units.what: Builds the shared perception signal every RTH minute and runs each enabled fleet arm off it.
units.breaks: All 5 real-fills arms stop trading while the core engine keeps going -- the book silently shrinks to one arm.

units.name: EOD flatten
units.what: 15:52-15:55 ET force-close of any 0DTE position still open, on every account.
units.breaks: A 0DTE position rides into expiry unmanaged. This is the single most expensive unattended failure in the rig.

units.name: TradingView eyes
units.what: Launches TradingView Desktop with CDP on :9222 at 08:00 and keeps it alive every 5 min.
units.breaks: No TV = no chart reads for premarket/levels/trendlines. Historically the 'no TV = no trades' outage class.

units.name: J intent executor
units.what: The standing deterministic path that arms a J-called trade without an LLM in the loop.
units.breaks: J calls a live entry and nothing picks it up -- the <60s arm path is dead and he finds out by watching nothing happen.

units.name: Broker fills / P&L
units.what: Pulls real broker fills every 10 min + at EOD into the C1 real-fills authority.
units.breaks: Every downstream P&L, win-rate and autopsy number quietly reports a stale book as current.

units.name: Ghost-order reconciler
units.what: Reconciles broker order state against local position state; clears orphaned/ghost orders.
units.breaks: A ghost order leaves the engine believing it is NOT flat, which blocks every subsequent entry (C11).

units.name: Entry-block watch
units.what: Records WHY entries were blocked each session so a silently-gated engine is visible.
units.breaks: A gate cascade that blocks 100% of entries looks identical to a quiet tape (C15).

units.name: Level refresh
units.what: Rewrites key-levels.json every 5 min (intraday) + snapshots the level set.
units.breaks: THE 2026-07-30 INCIDENT. Levels expire, the read returns empty, and the engine falls through to its worst cohort (trendline-only) instead of halting. 772 blind ticks before anyone noticed.

units.name: Level memory (G11)
units.what: Multi-day level memory + prior RTH close, merged into the live level set.
units.breaks: Multi-day levels silently stop appearing; gap_and_go measures the gap off a stale prior close.

units.name: Premarket pipeline
units.what: 08:30 ET bias + levels + loss budget + circuit-breaker re-arm, plus the 08:20 EMA pre-seed.
units.breaks: The daily-loss kill switch anchors to a PRIOR day's equity and the bias file reads yesterday as today.

units.name: Premarket readiness gate
units.what: 09:00 ET go/no-go gate, including the levels_sanity check built after the blind-engine incident.
units.breaks: The gate not running looks EXACTLY like the gate passing. This unit exists because that already happened once.

units.name: Context bundle
units.what: Every-5-min RTH bundle of the engine's analytical context.
units.breaks: Tick analysis quality degrades (the tick logs an absent bundle -- this one degrades LOUDLY by design).

units.name: Trendline engine
units.what: Wick-anchored trendline detection every 5 min RTH.
units.breaks: Confluence zones get built from yesterday's lines with no marker on them.

units.name: Confluence zones
units.what: Fuses level memory + trendlines + prior close into ranked zones every 10 min.
units.breaks: COMPOUNDING failure: emits plausible-looking zones even when all three inputs are a day old.

units.name: Macro calendar / scout
units.what: 05:45 ET macro calendar + 03:30 ET premarket scout sweep.
units.breaks: A stale calendar reads as 'no events today' -- the rig trades an FOMC print blind.

units.name: Trade-today watcher
units.what: Every 2 min RTH: did we actually trade today, and what filled.
units.breaks: J's 'did it trade today' surface reports an ACTIVE day as IDLE (this is L244, already burned once).

units.name: Regime meters
units.what: Chop meter, regime stamp, regime attribution, violin metric.
units.breaks: Regime stratification in analysis silently runs on a stale stamp (C5).

units.name: Options/OI data bank
units.what: CBOE open-interest banking + theta clock.
units.breaks: GEX/OI-derived context goes stale without saying so.

units.name: Watcher fleet
units.what: Live watcher observations + nightly grading of watcher calls.
units.breaks: The shadow observation stream that feeds promotion gates stops accruing evidence.

units.name: Live watch surface
units.what: The dashboard's live-watch state producer.
units.breaks: The dashboard's live panel freezes on a stale frame with no staleness marker.

units.name: Engine health beacon
units.what: Every-minute fused health verdict over 18 live-path checks.
units.breaks: THE WATCHER ITSELF. While this is down every other RED in the rig is invisible.

units.name: Self check
units.what: Every-30-min broad self-consistency sweep across state and config.
units.breaks: Config/state drift accumulates undetected between sessions.

units.name: Task-state guard
units.what: Every 30 min: detects tasks flipped Disabled or whose triggers stopped repeating.
units.breaks: A task silently flipped to Disabled goes unnoticed -- the exact mechanism behind the blind-engine incident.

units.name: Scheduled-task audit
units.what: Daily registry-vs-reality reconciliation of every Gamma_* task (fires under Gamma_CryptoDaily).
units.breaks: Orphan/stale/window-leak task drift accumulates silently in SCHEDULED-TASKS.md.

units.name: Gym session
units.what: 17:00 ET daily physical exam -- 7 audits fused into one scorecard.
units.breaks: The daily correctness/latency exam stops running; validator regressions land unseen.

units.name: Guard suite (nightly)
units.what: 22:30 ET run of the graduated-guard pytest suite, including the slow live-trigger guards.
units.breaks: Every regression a guard was written to catch can re-land silently -- guards are only real while they run.

units.name: Gate recency / expiry
units.what: Every armed gate carries a revalidation clock; this checks recency and expiry nightly.
units.breaks: A gate stays armed on stale evidence -- J 2026-07-31: block_elite_bull blocked a perfect 11/11 setup 111 times.

units.name: Free-model audit
units.what: Periodic Claude-grading of every free-model decision touchpoint (>=85% bar).
units.breaks: Free models keep vetoing live decisions with no measured accuracy behind them.

units.name: MCP audit
units.what: Daily MCP wiring + credential reachability audit.
units.breaks: A stale/401 key reads as 'connected' until an order fails at the worst moment.

units.name: GitHub secrets audit
units.what: Nightly secret + privacy scan of every tracked file before anything reaches the PUBLIC repo.
units.breaks: A credential can reach a public GitHub repo unreviewed. Irreversible.

units.name: Window-leak detector
units.what: Watches for console windows flashing on J's screen from automation fires.
units.breaks: Popups start flashing on J's desktop again -- the #1 'don't disturb the user' regression.

units.name: Context budget guard
units.what: Daily check that CLAUDE.md stays under its 9K token budget.
units.breaks: The always-loaded prefix bloats and every session's attention degrades.

units.name: Unattended health (this)
units.what: The every-10-min collector that produces these traffic lights.
units.breaks: EVERY OTHER BUBBLE FREEZES on its last known value and the tile quietly lies. The outer guard is the snapshot-age banner on the tile itself -- a monitor cannot be its own last line of defence.

units.name: Self audit (gap finder)
units.what: Daily sweep for gaps between what doctrine claims and what the rig does.
units.breaks: Doctrine-vs-reality drift accumulates -- the class that produced 'the rig never traded' in 2026-06.

units.name: Manager daily verify
units.what: 15:30 ET verification that every phase of the daily loop actually ran.
units.breaks: A missing phase in the daily loop goes unreported -- silence reads as success (C7).

units.name: OOS check
units.what: Nightly out-of-sample re-check of ratified edges.
units.breaks: A ratified edge decays out-of-sample with nothing measuring it.

units.name: Kitchen (R&D loop)
units.what: 24/7 free-tier autonomous R&D: keepalive daemon + :20 seeder + 2h reviewer.
units.breaks: The continuous strategy-search loop stops. Silent: kitchen-status.json keeps serving its last payload.

units.name: Prospector
units.what: Every-4h idea prospecting into the ideas ledger.
units.breaks: The idea intake dries up and the queue empties without anyone noticing (OP-25 requires a non-empty queue).

units.name: Free swarm
units.what: Engine-stress swarm (2h) + premarket swarm consult -- free-tier adversarial review.
units.breaks: Second-order review of engine changes stops; premarket context loses its adversarial pass.

units.name: Crypto twin
units.what: 24/7 engine twin on Alpaca crypto paper + sentinel + weekly chaos drill.
units.breaks: The only 24/7 mechanism-validation ground goes dark; engine bugs lose their fastest detector.

units.name: Crypto gym
units.what: Validator gym: daily full run, grinder keepalive, 30-min regression.
units.breaks: The 42-validator harness stops proving the chart-reading pipeline still reads charts correctly.

units.name: Shadow eval
units.what: Nemotron shadow scoring, shadow-signal audit, live shadow validator.
units.breaks: Shadow candidates stop accruing graded evidence -- promotion decisions lose their clock.

units.name: Shadow rails
units.what: Bold tier rail + ladder-rung + ER30 regime shadow pre-registrations.
units.breaks: Pre-registered shadow arms stop recording would-be decisions; their clocks silently stop -- and a stopped clock is indistinguishable from a clock with nothing to record (the 2026-08-15 stop_mode finding).

units.name: Incident fix roster
units.what: Daily 07:30 re-verification that the fixes from the 2026-08-14 loss morning are STILL landed (incident_fix_status.py). Silent unless one regresses.
units.breaks: A shipped incident fix can silently un-land -- reverted, refactored away, or half-landed across call sites -- and nothing notices until the same loss repeats. UNREGISTERED until 2026-08-15: this task guarded the roster while nothing guarded the task.

units.name: Kalshi lane
units.what: Autonomous Kalshi weather lane: scores its own settled predictions against NOAA GHCN and trades ONLY cities past a per-city scorecard bar.
units.breaks: An unproven city silently stays in shadow (the design intent) OR the lane stops scoring entirely and nobody notices -- the whole point of the per-city bar is that it advances without anyone remembering to check it.

units.name: Futures program
units.what: MES/MNQ mirror-shadow + SSR forward shadow + edge-3 sim + the autonomous intraday lane (fillsim book lane + tastytrade SANDBOX real-fill parity lane) and its EOD.
units.breaks: The futures forward-shadow clock stops accruing -- the whole program's only live evidence source. With the intraday lane dark, the real-fill parity question (the thing that unblocked this program) stops accumulating evidence too.

expect_disabled.Gamma_ConductorRTH: DISABLED 2026-07-25 cost pass -- job covered by the $0 deterministic path

units.breaks: Approved changes never land, and 1000+ generated candidate files sit untracked (L242/L252).

units.name: Free manager loop
units.what: Free-tier manager loop driving queue triage every 20 min.
units.breaks: The $0 autonomy layer stops triaging -- work backs up onto paid fires.

units.name: Contender ranker
units.what: Every-30-min ranking of strategy contenders.
units.breaks: Candidates stop being ranked; the shortlist J reads goes stale.

units.name: Dress rehearsal
units.what: Nightly end-to-end rehearsal of the trading path against replayed conditions.
units.breaks: The nightly end-to-end proof that the path still places+fills stops running.

units.name: Dojo manifest
units.what: Builds the daily bar-replay training manifest.
units.breaks: Replay training loses its daily source manifest.

units.name: Participation daily
units.what: Daily participation-rate accrual (how much of the tape the engine actually acts on).
units.breaks: The engine's participation trend stops accruing.

units.name: Grind pipeline
units.what: On-demand multi-worker backtest grind + funnel workers. Off between grinds by design.
units.breaks: Nothing while idle -- this unit is expected OFF. It is listed so its 'off' is documented rather than mysterious.

units.name: EOD pipeline
units.what: 16:00-16:30 ET: summary, brief, deep dive, full audit, analyst review, trade + winner autopsy, winner signature.
units.breaks: The learn-from-the-day loop stops. No autopsy, no hypothesis queue, no graded digest (OP-25).

artifacts._why_these_five: ADDED 2026-08-15. The fold contract is 'fail-open, never fatal', so a folded shadow producer can error every night -- or never be wired at all -- while winner-autopsy-last.json above stays perfectly fresh and this unit reads OK. Watching only the PARENT is exactly how entry-quality-ledger.json sat frozen at 2026-08-06 for five trading days and pinned an ARMED prereg's forward clock at n_trades=0 / ARMED_AWAITING_FILLS, a state indistinguishable from a real absence of fills. criticality=medium on purpose (YELLOW, never RED -- a dead research clock is not a trading emergency and a tile that REDs for one gets ignored). date_field is each artifact's OWN BUILD STAMP, never a data-derived date: a data date parks on the last day WITH fills, so keying freshness off it would alarm every time the engine correctly sat out.
artifacts.consumer: stop_mode_shadow_ledger reads this ENRICHED artifact deliberately (build_population() carries no trigger_level, so structure stops could never fire). SILENT DEGRADE: the artifact freezes and the forward clock accrues 0 trades forever while reporting ARMED_AWAITING_FILLS. THE 2026-08-15 FINDING.

the STOP-MODE-STRUCTURE-VS-PREMIUM-2026-08-09 forward clock toward its 20-day bar. SILENT DEGRADE: a frozen clock never reaches the bar, so a pre-registered A/B simply never becomes runnable and nothing says why.
the V-d1/V-e3 forward prereg's F1-F5 gates. SILENT DEGRADE: the forward window stops advancing and the gates are adjudicated on a short count that looks complete.
the weekly conviction would_block distribution (DISARMED / measurement only). SILENT DEGRADE: the post-fix population stops growing and the weekly read reports an old window as current.

entry_quality_ledger.load_pain_index() joins MFE/MAE from here (the ONE frozen excursion implementation, L251). SILENT DEGRADE: the enriched ledger keeps building but every new event loses its MFE join, so excursion analysis quietly narrows to the old population.

units.name: Briefs & standups
units.what: Morning brief, firm brief, AM/EOD standup, open-bell status.
units.breaks: J wakes up to no signal. OP-25: every fire must ship work OR a flagged failure.

units.name: Weekly reviews
units.what: Weekly review, treasurer portfolio review, Monday verify, risky-divergence weekly.
units.breaks: Sizing/risk drift goes a full week+ unreviewed; the weekly cadence silently skips.

units.name: Obsidian vault sync
units.what: Regenerates the vault's hubs, maps and indices -- J's reading surface.
units.breaks: MAP.md / HOME.md / SHADOW.md freeze; every session's routing table goes stale.

units.name: Spend summary
units.what: Nightly token/API spend census.
units.breaks: Cost blows up unmeasured -- exactly how the $160/day conductor burn hid for weeks.

units.name: Discord presence
units.what: Bridge + responder + watcher daemons -- the two-way channel to J.
units.breaks: J's only push channel goes silent; approvals and REVOKEs never reach him.

units.name: Infra keepalives
units.what: Dashboard, companion UI and claude-code-router keepalives (every 5 min) + the market-hours keep-awake that stops the box sleeping through a session.
units.breaks: The dashboard/companion die quietly; CCR death once silently killed a whole premarket. If the keep-awake dies the box can sleep through RTH -- the 2026-08-14 04:27-09:46 sleep produced a double entry and a blind first tick.

units.name: Ledger retention
units.what: Daily archive/prune of append-only ledgers (OP-22 consolidation).
units.breaks: Append-only ledgers grow unbounded until a reader chokes on them.

units.name: License monitor
units.what: Notify-only recency detector for external license/entitlement state.
units.breaks: An entitlement lapse (e.g. a data plan) is discovered by a failing fetch instead of a warning.

external_units.what: Daily git sync of the read-only SwjshAlgoKnife strategy reservoir.
external_units.breaks: The reservoir stops updating; extracted patterns go stale.
